text_block_list.text:
One morning, taking a glance at a flyer 
that had been dropped in the mailbox—

"Grand Opening of the Station-Front 
Aquarium!" "Providing a space for 
relaxation and healing."
choice_data_list:
I wonder if that'll be a nice breather for 
<chrname>.

text_block_list.text:
Since I had the chance, I decided to go 
invite her... With flyer in hand, I went 
searching for her.

And so, we arrived at the training course 
with the highest potential, however...

Unfortunately, my trainee was nowhere to 
be found. Just as I turned to leave, 
thinking I'd invite her next time—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh...! Good grief. That Umamusume's 
running with a completely different 
sharpness than before!"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
She's barely started her specialized 
training, yet she's growing at that 
rate... She truly is on a different level.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kiryuin...!!

A crowd seems to have gathered. Curious, I 
peek into the center and see...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Good work, Meek. That was a good run.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However, you lost your focus a bit at the 
end. With your current skill, you should 
be able to accelerate even more.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Keep focused so your momentum doesn't 
break at the end. Don't worry, you can do 
this!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, Trainer. I'll do my best. ...Mun!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She is the heir to the prestigious Kiryuin 
family of trainers, renowned for raising 
countless champion Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
The top scorer of the previous term's 
licensing exam, Trainer Aoi Kiryuin...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Her trainee Happy Meek didn't stand out 
much before, but... she's shown remarkable 
growth...!

It seems the duo drawing everyone's 
attention is Trainer Kiryuin and her 
Umamusume, Happy Meek...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Um, excuse me!! Could you possibly 
be...?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I knew it! Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ah, I'm sorry to spring this on you 
so suddenly...! But I... have always loved 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. ......Who is this?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm so sorry, Meek, leaving you behind 
all of a sudden like that...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... My apologies for losing my 
composure. Allow me to say once more—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Pleased to meet you, my name is Aoi 
Kiryuin! Like you, I'm a trainer 
affiliated with the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This is Happy Meek, whom I train. Meek, 
could you please say hello?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I am Happy Meek. ............Hello.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer <username>, you might not know this, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you and I were assigned to 
Tracen Academy at almost the exact same 
time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And so, if you'll forgive me, I felt a 
certain closeness to you... as if we were 
peers.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I've been hoping to talk with you someday.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, could we continue to 
exchange opinions in the future?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much! I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Um, Meek? It's rude to stare like 
that, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. ...I'm sorry.

Still, Happy Meek's gaze remains fixed 
over here. Following where she's looking—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh... An aquarium flyer? Bitter Glasse, 
were you looking at this the whole 
time...?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. ...Jellyfish, floating gently. 
...Ooooh~.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Meek looks so happy. I had no idea 
she liked aquariums so much.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But... was it really alright for me to 
come along too...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. The Kiryuin family teachings... 
the "Trainer White Paper" also states, 
"Uma Musume require moderate rest."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I was told we should leave 
it to the Umamusume so they could relax 
and unwind freely, so...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Was it really alright for me to come 
along? Won't my presence keep you from 
relaxing...?

It seems the serious Trainer Kiryuin is 
worried about going against her family's 
teachings. However—

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. ...This starfish looks like 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I'll tell you later. ...Heheheh.
I think Happy Meek is—
choice_data_list: I'm so happy you could come with me!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is that true?
choice_data_list:
I think it's important to grow closer with 
your trainee

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: The distance...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... until today, I had 
no idea that Meek liked aquariums."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Do I... still not understand her at 
all...?

After enjoying the aquarium with Trainer 
Kiryuin and the others, we returned to the 
academy and saw Happy Meek back to her 
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much for today, Trainer 
<username>."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Not just for inviting me... but for 
imparting such wonderful teachings as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Although "know your assigned 
Umamusume well" is written near the very 
beginning of the Trainer White Paper—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I thought it meant, 'Make sure you 
thoroughly understand your physical 
capabilities.'

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
“Still... thanks to talking with you 
today, I feel like I've finally understood 
the true meaning.”
choice_data_list: It's really not that big of a deal...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're being too modest.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm beginning to understand why 
Chairwoman Akikawa holds you in such high 
regard.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The earnest, devoted gaze you fix upon 
your trainee... That is truly your 
greatest strength as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I will devote myself even more to my 
training so that you won't leave me 
behind!

—After that, Trainer Kiryuin and I made 
our way back to the trainers' dormitory, 
talking about training philosophies as we 
walked.
